summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a Springpole Project Consultation and Benefits Agreement with Cat Lake First Nation and Lac Seul First Nation. The agreement covers construction, operation, and closure, including environmental stewardship, training, employment, and financial benefits. No financial terms, share prices, or special-situation mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine project development milestone, not a special situation. The filing is a standard current report on Form 6-K; therefore, it does not fit any special-situations category.
